simple.meaning: עֲטַלֵּף (ʻăṭallêph) is a Hebrew word meaning “a bat.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֲטַלֵּף (H5847) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 11:19, with occurrences in Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲטַלֵּף (H5847) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֲטַלֵּף (H5847) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֲטַלֵּף (ʻăṭallêph) / H5847 is traced through Leviticus 11:19, Deuteronomy 14:18, Isaiah 2:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
